prop.name: text
prop.help: The label text shown next to the checkbox

part.name: main
part.help: The label and its area: text properties; `pad_column` sets the gap between the tick box and the text.

part.name: indicator
part.help: The tick box: background, border, shadow and padding properties. `bg_image_src` sets the check icon. Use the 'checked' state (e.g. indicator|checked) for the checked look.
